verdicts.reason: The two layouts are almost the same. Both have the same weak structure: the subcopy and CTA column starts at x≈357 and doesn't line up with the headline's left edge, there is a large dead area at the top right, and the pink LIMITED badge sits beside the CTA and competes with it instead of staying a small tag. A breaks the subcopy as 'Draw / closes Thursday.', which is cleaner, but its badge floats off on its own near the right edge. B leaves 'Thursday.' orphaned on the second line and crowds the button up under the copy, though its badge sits closer to the CTA. The orphan in B is the bigger flaw, so A edges it.
